description: talks to the camera like a lively salesman: the mouth opens and closes over and over as if speaking, and whenever it opens the inside is only a deep crimson bottomless void, no teeth, no tongue; the head nods and tilts a little, the shoulders sway, the hand holding the microphone moves it slightly toward the mouth and back; the outstretched right arm and open hand stay perfectly still; then settles back into the starting pose
subject_description: a TV home shopping host in a black suit, white shirt and dark red tie, unnaturally white made-up face, large completely black eyes, holding a microphone, in front of an arch of unlit bulbs
initial_pose: turned three-quarters to the right, leaning forward, closed-lip smile, microphone in his left hand near his chest, right arm stretched down to the right with the open palm beside a turntable
